Plan-review (PASS 1, anti-slop) note for reviewers of a NEW plan proposing `tests/external/live_jira_dc/test_dc_richtext_agentic_probe.py` + `.github/workflows/jira-dc-richtext-probe.yml`, an agentic in-CI investigator whose sole cited done-definition is root-causing this bug (reckless-diabolic-kob).

This bug is CLOSED (completion-verifier PASS, live replication GREEN on run 33137402410). The root cause — a `sync --only` scope-check drop misclassifying a bound-issue update as `scope_deferred` — was proven via (a) the deterministic `test_live_rich_text_direct_wire_probe` (already in `test_dc_rich_text_live.py`, which PUTs the exact outbound wire and reads back raw+rendered, discriminating applier vs codec vs storage) and (b) targeted in-subprocess breadcrumb instrumentation, per the RCA comment. Flagging as a YAGNI/premature concern for the new plan: its motivating done-definition appears already satisfied, and the heavier agentic-`exec()`-over-reconciler-internals instrument was not what cracked this case. Raising so the plan author can confirm whether a still-open need justifies the new tool.
